title: MedResearch Suite
description: MedResearch Suite is a desktop workbench for clinical research and biostatistics that runs on the user's own computer: literature discovery, sample size, statistical analysis, diagnostic accuracy, pairwise and network meta-analysis, and publication figures, with its statistics checked against R. This record archives the project's public website repository as built on 5 November 2026 so the software can be cited. The Windows and macOS downloads are at https://medresearchsuite.com.
